items.title: Automate Active Directory joins for Elastic Beanstalk Windows applications
items.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk now joins your Windows Server instances to an Active Directory domain automatically at launch, before your application deploys, with no join scripts and no stored domain credentials. This walkthrough shows how to set it up, confirm the join, and see how Elastic Beanstalk reports a failed join without failing your deployment.
items.creator: Mohammad Ibrahim
